entities.summary: Kangal is a town in Sivas Province in Turkey. It is the seat of Kangal District. Its population is 8,948 (2022). The current mayor is Ahmet Kürşad Apaydın from the Great Unity Party (BBP). Kangal is a town in West Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
